## VaultV1InKindRedeemAction interface

Metadata for a Vault V1 in-kind redemption into Morpho Blue supply positions.

export interface VaultV1InKindRedeemAction extends BaseAction<"vaultV1InKindRedeem", {

    readonly deadline: bigint;
